tools.name: mcp__ccd_turn__wrap_up
tools.description:
Fill the "next step" box the app shows at the end of your turn: a two-or-three-sentence recap and, when this turn leaves the user a decision to make or a step to take, one question and buttons that answer it; a turn with nothing pending ends with the recap alone, and the app then draws no box. Call it once in EVERY turn in which you kept a task list, changed files, ran commands, or completed multi-step work: when this turn's work is done, before any closing message (it also checks off the task list; no closing update_plan is needed). Skip it for short answers, pure conversation, or a brief read-and-explain turn — a reply that names a follow-up is not brief: ask or propose it, and call this.

Your closing message is ordinary text right after this call, the last thing you say this turn: your answer to the user in full, which the recap never replaces. Never write it before this call, where it can reach the user cut to a short summary. The result says whether the box shows your question: ask in the message only a question it does not show.

Fields — recap and ask are said to the user, in the second person; a reply button's label is the user's words back to you:
- recap: what is now true or changed, then where it stands, including what is not done or not verified (for example: nothing committed, or not checked in the app). Two or three short sentences, about 40 words / 300 characters, in the project's own words. No recommendation here.
- ask (with actions, only when the next move is the user's call — a choice of approach, a go-ahead to fix, commit, push, post or send, an approval): just that ONE decision in one short sentence, never two joined by "and" ("Which fix first?"), with no reason or recommendation and without listing the options the buttons give: your pick, actions[0], is drawn as the primary button. At most 100 characters.
Every field is a top-level parameter holding plain prose (actions: a JSON array); none contains markup or another field.

recap.description: Two or three short sentences to the user (≤300 chars): what is now true or changed, then where it stands, including what is not done or not verified. Its first sentence is the sidebar status. It must stand on its own, since it is also read away from the transcript and the box draws under anything you write after this call: never point at anything else in the conversation ("listed below", "see above", "in my message").

ask.description: The one question (≤100 chars) when the next move is the user's call — a choice, a go-ahead (to act here on what this turn found, say), an approval: the decision alone, with no reason or recommendation and without listing the options the buttons give (actions[0] is your pick). blocked.description: true when your work stops here until the user answers (the app marks the session as waiting on them); omit when the answer can wait.

action.description: An app action update_plan's result listed as available now, or one your own work this turn made available; anything else is refused, and one that stops being available later is dropped (as actions[0], with your ask and the other answers), so do not guess. Omit for a reply.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

For computer items whose action is left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key or type, and for form_input items, include action_summary in the item's input, as you would when calling that tool directly.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). clauses (v0.1) and the contract identifier: "HandlePool v0.5" or "DS-v2", stated as non-normative.
Agents H (`formal/Ern/Lib/HandlePool.lean`) and D (`formal/Ern/Lib/DataStack.lean`) run in parallel:
never run `lake build`; check with `cd formal && ~/.elan/bin/lake env lean Ern/Lib/<File>.lean`.

## HandlePool v0.5 = HandlePool v0.4 annex (Annex D of `~/Downloads/ERN_MM-03.3_v0.4_pour_validation.md`, lines 687–725) with these changes

- HP5-1 `freeSlot` (Q3). Preconditions: administration right (`AdminRight`: live pool, `MetaRight` =
  `Modify` exercisable on the pool value, §36); valid handle; no leaf of the entry is `Init` (each is
  `Uninit` or `Moved`); no active authority derived from a companion of this pool (a strict
  descendant of a companion recorded for this pool) covers a leaf of the entry. Effect: the slot
  becomes free and its generation is incremented; NO end-of-use effect: the kernel state is unchanged.
  Outcome order: keep the existing order of `FreeSlotStep` (`reject` without pool or right, then `fail`
  on an invalid handle, then `reject` on the content conditions); Q5 concerns resolution (§89) and is
  not extended to `freeSlot` (report this as a point for the user).
  Remove what only served the v0.4 `freeSlot`: `Exempt`, `DyingAccessOK`, `ContentAnchorOK`,
  `ContentEndPre`, `contentEnd_*`, `freeSlot_preserves*` on `endUseEff`, `freeSlot_lands_in_reachable`
  and the HP-4 step-level discussion (moot: no kernel effect), and the v0.4 obligation
  `pool_freeSlot_ends_content`.
- HP5-2 Mandatory proof (1) (Q3, follow-up): a complete witness from `PState.init statics` by accepted
  steps: `newPool`, `allocSlot`, `resolve` in `Modify`, a write of the entry through the resolved entry
  authority (kernel `write`), `transfer` of the entry's value to a local of the same shape, `unresolve`,
  then `freeSlot` accepted. `internal` must be DERIVED (as in the corpus pools: derived from the
  storage root and stored in the pool value). The transfer relies on the v0.1 §63.4 exemption (the
  entry, the companion, `internal` and its origins ground the right). "Local": prefer a place created
  by `enterFrame` (§72) owned by the current frame; if that is infeasible in the run, use a static
  `Uninit` place directly owned by frame 0 and say why in the docstring and report.
- HP5-3 Mandatory proof (2) (Q3): the metadata update of `freeSlot` (free state, generation) is
  realizable by an authorized write under the administration right: for every library-reachable state
  and pool with `AdminRight`, the kernel `write` (§67, `Write3Pre`) of the leaves of the pool value
  (the place holding `internal`) is accepted. If the effect of that write is the identity on the
  kernel state (the pool value's leaves are `Init`, §76.5), state it too.
- HP5-4 Per-pool guarantees (Q4): D.2 ("une compagne `Modify` active bloque les nouvelles compagnes"),
  the `freeSlot` content condition, and D.4(3) ("`freeSlot` n'aboutit jamais si une descendante active
  d'une compagne couvre le slot") concern the companions of the slot's pool. `PoolInv` = entries
  disjoint and in the storage + `pool_no_stale_access` + the per-pool `freeSlot` guarantee;
  `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive` per pool. Nested pools stay allowed. Remove the v0.4 literal versions
  and their refutation witnesses (n10, e*/g* entry routes, `*_false`), keeping the `*_same_pool`
  results under their new names.
- HP5-5 Resolution order (Q5): handle validation precedes the right check: `resolve` and `resolveMany`
  give `fail` on an invalid handle before checking `ResolveRight`. A handle of a dead pool (internal
  inactive) is stale: `fail`. A missing pool index stays `reject`.

198	+  | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; rw [ancs_append rfl hx]; exact hw
199	+  | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; rw [ancs_append rfl hx]; exact hw
200	+  | release hs =>
201	+    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
202	+    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hp.active
203	+    rw [release_ancs hy]; exact hw
204	+  | transfer hs =>
205	+    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; rw [(transfer_skel _ _ _).ancs]; exact hw
206	+  | depend hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hw
207	+  | enter hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; rw [Frames.enter_ancs_lt hx]; exact hw
208	+  | exit hs =>
209	+    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
210	+    obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := hwa
211	+    obtain ⟨z₀, -, rfl⟩ := Frames.exit_get hz
212	+    exact Frames.exit_ancs_keep (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) w hw (Frames.exitG_active za)
213	+  | read hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hw
214	+  | write hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hw
215	+  | writeShared hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hw

218	+  | endUse hs =>
219	+    rename_i p
220	+    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
221	+    rw [show endUseEff s p = cleanup (endUseS s p) from rfl,
222	+      ((EndFree.endUseS_releases s p).trans (EndFree.cleanup_releases _)).ancs]

234	+/-- A sequence of kernel steps keeps on the origin chain of a former authority every ancestor still

245	+/-- The companion and the entry authorities of every ghost resolution, while active, have the
246	+`internal` of their pool on their origin chain as long as `internal` is active (auxiliary, not a

248	+authority from the companion; §42, §73.4). -/

250	+  ∀ r ∈ L.res, ∀ x ∈ r.comp :: r.entries.map (·.1), L.kern.Active x →

257	+  obtain ⟨sh, -, -, -, hlt, hc, he⟩ := hw.res r hr
258	+  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hc
259	+  have hc' := lt_of_getElem? hy
260	+  refine ⟨Nat.lt_trans hlt hc', fun x hx => ?_⟩
261	+  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
262	+  · exact hc'
263	+  · obtain ⟨e, he', rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
264	+    obtain ⟨-, q, -, ho⟩ := he e he'
265	+    obtain ⟨z, hz, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 ho
266	+    exact lt_of_getElem? hz

268	+/-- A companion of origin `i` and entry authorities of origin the companion have `i` on their

272	+    (he : ∀ e ∈ es, c < e ∧ OptP (s.A[e]?) (fun y => y.origin = some c) False) :

274	+  obtain ⟨yc, hyc, hoc⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hc
275	+  have hci : i ∈ s.ancs c := by
276	+    unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hyc, hoc]) hic]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
277	+  intro x hx
278	+  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
279	+  · exact hci
280	+  · obtain ⟨hlt, ho⟩ := he x hx
281	+    obtain ⟨y, hy, hoy⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 ho
282	+    unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, hoy]) hlt]

304	+    show r.internal ∈ s'.ancs x

309	+/-- Every library step keeps `ResAnc` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §42, §73.4): kernel steps and
310	+`unresolve` keep every active ancestor on the chains (`KSeq.ancs_keep`), `newPool`, `allocSlot` and
311	+`freeSlot` change neither the authorities nor the resolutions, and `resolve` and `resolveMany` add
312	+a companion of origin `internal` and entry authorities of origin the companion (§60, §61). -/
313	+theorem pstep_resAnc {k : K} {L L' : PState} (hw : PoolWF L) (h : ResAnc L) (hs : PStep k L L') :
314	+    ResAnc L' := by
315	+  cases hs with
316	+  | kernel hs => exact h.kseq hw (KSeq.single hs)
317	+  | newPool hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact h
318	+  | allocSlot hs =>
319	+    cases hs with
320	+    | ok => exact h
321	+  | @resolve _ _ _ m hs =>
322	+    cases hs with
323	+    | @ok pl sl _ _ hR _ _ =>
324	+      obtain ⟨xi, hxi, -⟩ := hR.active
325	+      have hAe := resolve_A L.kern pl m (footprint L.kern.P sl.place)
326	+      refine h.addRes hw hAe (anc_new (lt_of_getElem? hxi) (by rw [hAe]; simp [OptP])
327	+        fun e he => ?_)
328	+      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.mem_singleton] at he
329	+      subst he
330	+      exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_self _, by rw [hAe]; simp [OptP]⟩
331	+  | @resolveMany _ _ hl m hs =>
332	+    cases hs with
333	+    | @ok pl _ _ hR _ =>
334	+      obtain ⟨xi, hxi, -⟩ := hR.active
335	+      have hAe := resolveMany_A m L.kern pl hl
336	+      refine h.addRes hw hAe (anc_new (lt_of_getElem? hxi) (by rw [hAe]; simp [OptP])
337	+        fun e he => ?_)
338	+      obtain ⟨e', he', rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 he
339	+      obtain ⟨n, h, hh, rfl⟩ := mem_batchEntries he'
340	+      refine ⟨by simp; omega, ?_⟩
341	+      rw [hAe, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
342	+      simp [show L.kern.A.length + 1 + n - L.kern.A.length = n + 1 by omega, hh, OptP]
343	+  | unresolve hs =>
344	+    cases hs with
345	+    | ok _ hr => exact h.kseq hw (releaseAll_kseq (k := k) hr)
346	+  | freeSlot hs =>
347	+    cases hs with
348	+    | ok => exact h

490	+/-- `pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc` (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (3) restricted to the companions of the
491	+slot's pool, HP5-4, as stated in round 1): on every library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80)
492	+and `StaticsOK` (§47), `freeSlot` never succeeds while an active strict descendant of a companion
493	+of the slot's pool covers a leaf of the slot (§42, §43). Under HP5-1' it follows from

5	
6	**Non-normative.** This module formalizes the library contract "HandlePool v0.5": the HandlePool

10	here"). The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` is exercisable `Modify` on the
11	administering value; `writeShared` alone is insufficient; the library adds no rights to the
12	kernel), §37 and §89 (handles are data, not authorities; a stale identity or generation leads to
13	defined failure), §38 and §46 (library state outside `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (the
14	guard over all registries of live administrations), §58 (outcomes) and §76 (the obligations of
15	`newArena` that `newPool` takes over).

18	kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75): `newPool` registers only; `allocSlot` writes the handle into

20	an entry authority from the companion (O1 twice); `resolveMany` does the same with `split` (O2) in
21	`Modify` and with one `Observe` derive per handle (O1) in `Observe`; `unresolve` releases (O3);
22	`freeSlot` updates the registry only (HP5-1). Every library step is thus, on the kernel side, a
23	finite sequence of accepted kernel steps (`pstep_kernel`), so, under `DDSound` (§80) and
24	`StaticsOK` (§47), every kernel state of a library run is kernel-reachable and satisfies the

52	/-- Handle `(poolId, slot, gen)`: data, not an authority (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §37, §89;
53	non-normative library contract). -/
54	structure Handle where
55	  id : Nat
56	  slot : Nat
57	  gen : Nat
58	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
59	
60	/-- Ghost record of a resolution (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; auxiliary information creating no right,
61	§38): pool identity and `internal`, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities tagged with
62	their slot and resolved generation. Read by `unresolve` and by the invariants. -/
63	structure Res where
64	  pool : Nat
65	  internal : Nat
66	  comp : Nat
67	  mode : Mode
68	  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
69	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
70	
71	/-- Library state (§38, §46; HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract): the kernel
72	state `S₃` and, separately, the pool registry, the next fresh pool identity and the ghost
73	resolutions. -/
74	structure PState where
75	  kern : S3
76	  pools : List Pool
77	  nId : Nat
78	  res : List Res
79	
80	/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1): the initial kernel state, an empty
81	registry. -/
82	def PState.init (statics : Statics) : PState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩
83	
84	/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse `MetaRight` of §36
85	(HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract). -/
86	def Pool.entry (pl : Pool) : Arena.ArenaEntry := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩
87	
88	/-- Administration right on the pool (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1;
89	non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active) and `MetaRight` holds,
90	exercisable `Modify` over the pool value; no `writeShared` branch. -/
91	def AdminRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Prop := s.Active pl.internal ∧ Arena.MetaRight s pl.entry
92	
93	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3). -/
94	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (AdminRight s pl) := by
95	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
96	
97	/-- Place of slot `i`, `0` if absent (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract;
98	§46). -/
99	def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0
100	
101	/-- The pool with slot `i` replaced (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract;
102	§46). -/
103	def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }
104	
105	/-! ## `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76) -/
106	
107	/-- The pool registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; HandlePool v0.5, D.1;
108	non-normative library contract): the `internal` identities of its live pools. -/
109	def liveInternals (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) : List Nat :=
110	  (pools.filter fun pl => decide (s.Active pl.internal)).map (·.internal)
111	
112	/-- Preconditions of `newPool(storage, internal)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library
113	contract; §56, §76). -/
114	structure NewPoolPre (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat))
115	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
116	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: "reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena`"
117	  (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, read on the resulting state as v0.1 §76.6 states it). -/
118	  base : Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal
119	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: every leaf of the input storage is `Uninit`. -/
120	  uninit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit
121	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1, §56: `internal` is absent from the pool registry and from every other
122	  registry of live administrations `others`. -/
123	  guard : Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal
124	
125	/-- Decidability of `NewPoolPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76). -/
126	instance (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
127	    Decidable (NewPoolPre s pools others storage internal) :=
128	  decidable_of_iff (Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
129	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit) ∧
130	    Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal)
131	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
132	
133	/-- Effect of `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract): a pool with the
134	fresh identity `nId`, one free slot of generation zero per child of the storage, the kernel state
135	unchanged (§46, §76). -/
136	def newPoolEff (L : PState) (storage internal : Nat) : PState :=
137	  { L with
138	    pools := L.pools ++ [⟨L.nId, storage, internal,
139	      (kids L.kern.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
140	    nId := L.nId + 1 }
141	
142	/-- `newPool` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §58; non-normative library contract): `ok` or
143	`reject`; `others` are the other registries of live administrations (§56). -/
144	def NewPoolStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : PState) :
145	    Outcome3 PState → Prop :=
146	  Guarded (NewPoolPre L.kern L.pools others storage internal) (newPoolEff L storage internal)
147	
148	/-! ## `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3) -/
149	
150	/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot(pool, dst)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36;
151	non-normative library contract). "Apte à recevoir la représentation d'un handle" names no state
152	component and is not represented. -/
153	structure AllocSlotStatic (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
154	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3, §36: live pool and `MetaRight`. -/
155	  right : AdminRight s pl
156	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` is usable. -/
157	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
158	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` is a leaf (the handle is written into "la seule feuille
159	  `dst`"). -/
160	  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
161	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3 with §67.1: the write of the handle needs exercisable `Modify` over
162	  `dst`. -/
163	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
164	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` is not `Init`. -/
165	  dstNotInit : s.I dst ≠ .init
166	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` holds no active authority. -/
167	  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
168	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
169	
170	/-- Decidability of `AllocSlotStatic` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §36, §67). -/
171	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (AllocSlotStatic s pl dst) :=
172	  decidable_of_iff (AdminRight s pl ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
173	    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧ ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
174	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True)
175	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
176	
177	/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library
178	contract): the slot becomes live with its generation kept; the handle is written into the leaf
179	`dst`, which alone becomes `Init` (§67 effect). -/
180	def allocSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PState :=
181	  { L with
182	    kern := write3Eff L.kern [dst]
183	    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) }
184	
185	/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` for slot `i` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library
186	contract; §37, §89). -/
187	def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
188	  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩
189	
190	/-- `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §58; non-normative library
191	contract): `reject` without the pool or a static precondition; then `fail` when no slot is free;
192	`ok` on any free slot. -/
193	inductive AllocSlotStep (j dst : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
194	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
195	  | static {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
196	      AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
197	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
198	      (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.live = true) → AllocSlotStep j dst L .fail
199	  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
200	      pl.slots[i]? = some sl → sl.live = false →
201	      AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok (allocSlotEff L j pl i sl dst))
202	
203	/-! ## `resolve`, `resolveMany` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5, HP5-6) -/
204	
205	/-- Validity of a handle for pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, D.3, HP5-5, HP5-6, HP5-1''; §89;
206	non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active, §46 analogue: a handle of a
207	dead pool is stale, HP5-5), the handle names the pool, and it designates a live slot at its
208	generation (a handle of a free entry is stale, HP5-6); a slot index outside the pool designates
209	nothing. -/
210	def HandleOK (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
211	  s.Active pl.internal ∧ h.id = pl.id ∧
212	    OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False
213	
214	/-- Decidability of `HandleOK` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §89). -/
215	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK s pl h) := by
216	  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance
217	
218	/-- Legal exercise of `internal` at mode `m` for the companion (HandlePool v0.5, D.2;
219	non-normative library contract): the preconditions of the `derive` of the companion from
220	`internal` over all leaves of the storage (§60). -/
221	def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
222	  DerivePre s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
223	
224	/-- Decidability of `ResolveRight` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60). -/
225	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
226	  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance
227	
228	/-- State after the companion (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60 effect; non-normative library contract):
229	authority `|A|`, derived from `internal` at mode `m` over all leaves of the storage. -/
230	def compS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
231	  deriveEff s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
232	
233	/-- Observe derivations from `c`, one per region in order (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: `resolveMany` in
234	`Observe`; §60; non-normative library contract): each accepted in the state left by the previous
235	ones. -/
236	def DerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → Prop
237	  | [] => True
238	  | r :: rs => DerivePre s c r .observe ∧ DerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
239	
240	/-- Decidability of `DerivesPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, §60). -/
241	instance decDerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) :
242	    (rs : List (List Nat)) → Decidable (DerivesPre s c rs)
243	  | [] => isTrue trivial
244	  | r :: rs =>
245	    have := decDerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
246	    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
247	
248	/-- Effect of the `Observe` derivations from `c`, in order (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60 effect). -/
249	def derivesEff (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → S3
250	  | [] => s
251	  | r :: rs => derivesEff (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
252	
253	/-- Entry authorities of a batch from the companion `c` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; non-normative
254	library contract): `split` (§61) in `Modify`, successive `Observe` derivations (§60) in
255	`Observe`. -/
256	def EntriesPre (k : K) : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → Prop
257	  | .modify, s, c, rs => SplitPre k s c rs
258	  | .observe, s, c, rs => DerivesPre s c rs
259	
260	/-- Decidability of `EntriesPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60, §61). -/
261	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (m : Mode) (s : S3) (c : Nat)
262	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (EntriesPre k m s c rs) := by
263	  cases m <;> unfold EntriesPre <;> infer_instance
264	
265	/-- Effect of the entry authorities of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60, §61 effects). -/
266	def entriesEff : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → S3
267	  | .modify, s, c, rs => splitEff s c rs
268	  | .observe, s, c, rs => derivesEff s c rs
269	
270	/-- Regions of the entries designated by a batch: the footprint of each slot (HandlePool v0.5,
271	D.2; non-normative library contract; §60). -/
272	def entryRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
273	  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)
274	
275	/-- Ghost entries of a batch: the `n`-th entry authority is `c + 1 + n`, for slot and generation of
276	the `n`-th handle (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; auxiliary, §38). -/
277	def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
278	  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs
279	
280	/-- `resolve(h, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5, HP5-6; §58, §89;
281	non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool; then `fail` for a handle of a dead
282	pool, of another pool, stale, absent or free, before the right is checked (HP5-5); then `reject`
283	without the legal exercise of `internal`; then the companion and the entry authority derived from
284	it, `reject` when the second derivation is not accepted. -/
285	inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
286	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
287	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h →
288	      ResolveStep j h m L .fail
289	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
290	      ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
291	  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
292	      ResolveRight L.kern pl m → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
293	      ¬ DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
294	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
295	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
296	      ResolveRight L.kern pl m → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
297	      DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
298	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok { L with
299	        kern := deriveEff (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m
300	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
301	          [(L.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
302	
303	/-- Validity of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; non-normative library contract): every
304	handle is valid (`HandleOK`); pairwise distinct slots in `Modify` only (§58, §89). -/
305	def BatchOK (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
306	  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK s pl h) ∧ (m = .modify → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup)
307	
308	/-- Decidability of `BatchOK` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58, §89). -/
309	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Decidable (BatchOK s pl hs m) := by
310	  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance
311	
312	/-- `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; §58;
313	non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool; then an atomic `fail` for an invalid
314	batch, before the right is checked (HP5-5); then `reject` without the legal exercise of
315	`internal`; then one companion and the entry authorities (`EntriesPre`), `reject` when they are
316	not accepted. -/
317	inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) :
318	    Outcome3 PState → Prop where
319	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
320	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
321	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .fail
322	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
323	      ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
324	  | noEntries {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
325	      ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
326	      ¬ EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
327	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
328	  | ok {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
329	      EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
330	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok { L with
331	        kern := entriesEff m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs)
332	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
333	          batchEntries L.kern.A.length hs⟩] })
334	
335	/-! ## `unresolve` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2) -/
336	
337	/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (§62); `none` as soon as one release is not
338	accepted (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: "Les règles de `release` … restent applicables"). -/
339	def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
340	  | s, [] => some s
341	  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none
342	
343	/-- The resolution of companion `c` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; ghost lookup, §38). -/
344	def findRes (L : PState) (c : Nat) : Option Res := L.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c
345	
346	/-- Authorities released by `unresolve` of `r` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; non-normative library
347	contract): the entry authorities still active, then the companion (§62). -/
348	def unresolveList (s : S3) (r : Res) : List Nat :=
349	  ((r.entries.map (·.1)).filter fun a => decide (s.Active a)) ++ [r.comp]
350	
351	/-- `unresolve(c)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58; non-normative library contract): the
352	releases of `unresolveList`; `reject` when one is not accepted or `c` is no companion. -/
353	inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
354	  | none : findRes L c = none → UnresolveStep c L .reject
355	  | reject {r : Res} : findRes L c = some r → releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = none →
356	      UnresolveStep c L .reject
357	  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes L c = some r →
358	      releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = some s' →
359	      UnresolveStep c L (.ok { L with kern := s' })
360	
361	/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 as amended by HP5-1, HP5-1', HP5-1'') -/
362	
363	/-- No active strict descendant of the `internal` of pool `pl` covers a leaf of place `q`
364	(HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by HP5-1': "aucune autorité active, descendante stricte de
365	internal de ce pool, ne couvre l'entrée"; §42: descendants along the current origin chain, which
366	covers the reanchoring of §73.4 onto `internal`; non-normative library contract). -/
367	def NoInternalDesc (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
368	  ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active x → pl.internal ∈ s.ancs x →
369	    ∀ l ∈ s.afp x, l ∉ footprint s.P q
370	
371	/-- Decidability of `NoInternalDesc` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1'; §42). -/
372	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (NoInternalDesc s pl q) := by
373	  unfold NoInternalDesc; infer_instance
374	
375	/-- Content conditions of `freeSlot` on slot place `q` of pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1,
376	HP5-1'; non-normative library contract; §41, §42). -/
377	structure FreeContentOK (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop where
378	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no leaf of the entry is `Init`; each is `Uninit` or `Moved`
379	  (§41). -/
380	  notInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init
381	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1': no active strict descendant of `internal` of this pool covers a
382	  leaf of the entry (§42). -/
383	  noDesc : NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q
384	
385	/-- Decidability of `FreeContentOK` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1, HP5-1'; §41, §42). -/
386	instance (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (FreeContentOK L pl q) :=
387	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q)
388	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
389	
390	/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1; non-normative library
391	contract): the slot becomes free and its generation is incremented; there is no end-of-use effect
392	and the kernel state is unchanged (§36: the library adds no rights to the kernel). -/
393	def freeSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PState :=
394	  { L with pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) }
395	
396	/-- `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1; outcome
397	order of HP5-1'' (Q5 extended to `freeSlot`); §58, §89; non-normative library contract): `reject`
398	without the pool; then `fail` for a handle of a dead pool, of another pool, stale, absent or free,
399	before the right is checked; then `reject` without the administration right (live pool and
400	`MetaRight`); then `reject` unless the content conditions hold (`FreeContentOK`); then `ok`. -/
401	inductive FreeSlotStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
402	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
403	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h → FreeSlotStep j h L .fail
404	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h → ¬ AdminRight L.kern pl →
405	      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
406	  | noContent {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
407	      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
408	      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
409	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
410	      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
411	      FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl))
412	
413	/-! ## Library runs (HandlePool v0.5; §38, §46, §47) -/
414	
415	/-- One `ok` step of a library run (HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract): a kernel
416	step O1–O16 of non-administrative code, the registry unchanged, or an accepted pool operation
417	(§58). -/
418	inductive PStep (k : K) : PState → PState → Prop where
419	  | kernel {L : PState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → PStep k L { L with kern := s' }
420	  | newPool {L L' : PState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
421	      NewPoolStep others st i L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
422	  | allocSlot {L L' : PState} {j dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
423	  | resolve {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} :
424	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
425	  | resolveMany {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
426	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
427	  | unresolve {L L' : PState} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
428	  | freeSlot {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L') →
429	      PStep k L L'
430	
431	/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps
432	(HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract). -/
433	inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PState → Prop where
434	  | init : PReach k statics (PState.init statics)
435	  | step {L L' : PState} : PReach k statics L → PStep k L L' → PReach k statics L'
436	
437	/-! ## Kernel side of the pool operations (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7) -/
438	
439	/-- Finite sequences of kernel steps O1–O16 (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
440	inductive KSeq (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
441	  | refl (s : S3) : KSeq k s s
442	  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : KSeq k s s₁ → KStep k s₁ s₂ → KSeq k s s₂
443	
444	/-- Sequences of kernel steps compose (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
445	theorem KSeq.trans {k : K} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} (h₁ : KSeq k s₁ s₂) (h₂ : KSeq k s₂ s₃) :
446	    KSeq k s₁ s₃ := by
447	  induction h₂ with
448	  | refl => exact h₁
449	  | tail _ hs ih => exact .tail ih hs
450	
451	/-- One kernel step is a sequence (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
452	theorem KSeq.single {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : KSeq k s s' := .tail (.refl s) h
453	
454	/-- Kernel reachability (§57) is closed under sequences of kernel steps (HandlePool v0.5,
455	HP5-7). -/
456	theorem KSeq.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
457	    (h : KSeq k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
458	  induction h with
459	  | refl => exact hr
460	  | tail _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs
461	
462	/-- `releaseAll` is a sequence of `release` steps (§62; HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
463	theorem releaseAll_kseq {k : K} : ∀ {s s' : S3} {l : List Nat}, releaseAll s l = some s' →
464	    KSeq k s s'
465	  | s, s', [], h => by simp only [releaseAll, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact .refl s
466	  | s, s', a :: l, h => by
467	    simp only [releaseAll] at h
468	    split at h
469	    · rename_i hpre
470	      exact (KSeq.single (.release (Guarded.ok hpre))).trans (releaseAll_kseq h)
471	    · cases h
472	
473	/-- The `Observe` derivations of `resolveMany` are a sequence of `derive` steps (§60;
474	HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
475	theorem derives_kseq {k : K} {c : Nat} : ∀ {s : S3} {rs : List (List Nat)}, DerivesPre s c rs →
476	    KSeq k s (derivesEff s c rs)
477	  | s, [], _ => .refl s
478	  | _, _ :: _, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok h₁))).trans (derives_kseq h₂)
479	
480	/-- The entry authorities of `resolveMany` are a `split` (§61) or a sequence of `derive` steps

/-! ## Parent chains (§40, §42) -/

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first, within fuel `k` (§40 structural
parents, §42 origins). Only links to a smaller index are followed (§49, last paragraph). -/
def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | k + 1, i =>
    match org i with
    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
    | none => []

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (§40, §42); fuel `i` suffices since the chain
decreases. -/
def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i

/-! ## Places, leaves, footprints (§40) -/

/-- Holder of an authority (§42) or owner of a place (§40): a frame or a place. -/
inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (§40): optional structural parent, owner, abstract `kind`. Its identity is its
index in `P`; its death marker is `S3.dead`. -/
structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

/-! ## Decidable helpers -/

/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
components of `S3` (§38). -/
def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | some y => P y
  | none => d

/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
  match o with
  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)

/-- An index with a value is in range (§38: identities are list indices). -/
theorem lt_of_getElem? {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : l[i]? = some x) :
    i < l.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1

/-! ## Least fixed points on a bounded universe

`Usable` (§40), `FrameOf` (§40), `OwnedIn` (§40) and `ExercisableAt` (§43) are inductive
predicates, each the least fixed point of a monotone rule over identities below a bound `n`; the
Kleene iteration is stable after `n + 1` steps, which makes them decidable. -/

/-- `k`-th Kleene iterate of a rule `R` on Boolean predicates over `Nat` (decision procedure for
§40 and §43). -/
def kiter (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => false
  | k + 1, a => R (kiter R k) a

/-- A monotone rule whose conclusions lie below `n` and which reads its premise only below `n`
(decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
structure KRule (n : Nat) (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Prop where
  mono : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, p a = true → q a = true) → ∀ a, R p a = true → R q a = true
  bound : ∀ p a, R p a = true → a < n
  loc : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, a < n → p a = q a) → ∀ a, R p a = R q a

/-- The iteration of a monotone rule is increasing (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem kiter_mono {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + 1) a = true
  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
  | k + 1, a, hk => h.mono _ _ (kiter_mono h k) a hk

/-- Conclusions of the iteration lie below the bound (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem kiter_bound {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → a < n
  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
  | _ + 1, a, hk => h.bound _ a hk

/-- `countP` is monotone in the predicate (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem countP_le_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true) :
    l.countP p ≤ l.countP q := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.countP_cons]
    have := ih fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega
  | k + 1, q, h => by
    simp only [kiter, owR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i pl hpl
      split at h
      · rename_i o ho
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        rcases h with h | ⟨-, h⟩
        · exact .direct hpl ho h
        · exact .step hpl ho (ownedIn_of_kiter P src k o h)
      · cases h
    · cases h

/-- `OwnedIn` is computed by `|P| + 1` steps of `owR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
theorem ownedIn_iff {P : List Place} {src q : Nat} :
    OwnedIn P src q ↔ kiter (owR P src) (P.length + 1) q = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ownedIn_of_kiter P src _ q⟩
  induction h with
  | direct hpl ho hp => exact kiter_up (owR_rule P src) 1 _ (by simp [kiter, owR, hpl, ho, hp])
  | step hpl ho ho' ih =>
    apply kiter_up (owR_rule P src) (P.length + 2) _
    show owR P src (kiter (owR P src) (P.length + 1)) _ = true
    simp [owR, hpl, ho, ih, ho'.lt]

/-- Decidability of `OwnedIn` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src q : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedIn P src q) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ ownedIn_iff.symm

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (§43). -/
def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
    match s.A[j]? with
    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
    | none => none

/-- Cases 2–4 of §43 for an active authority of own mode `m` covering the leaf, whose covering
active descendants have modes `ds`. -/
def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe

/-- `effective(s, a, l)` (§43, cases 1–4), computed per leaf. -/
def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
  | none => none

/-- Compatible effective modes for independent ordinary accesses: only `Observe`/`Observe`
(§50). -/
def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
§43). -/
theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
    l.any f = l.any g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source`, its effective anchor included, is
  active. -/
  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ (∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5,
§76.6). §76.6 is read on the resulting state (v0.1 §76.6): its kernel component is `s`, since
`newArena` changes no kernel component (§76 `ok` effect, `newArena_kernel`), so `WF3`, `I1`,
`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are required of the whole kernel state `s`; the new entry is
the one `newArenaEff` registers, `available` holding the leaves of the storage and `issued`
empty, and it must satisfy `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True
  /-- §76.6: `WF3` (§49) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  wf3 : WF3 s
  /-- §76.6: `I1` (§50) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  i1 : I1 s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrder` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld s
  /-- §76.6: the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
  arenaInv : ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True ∧
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧

/-- Ghost entries of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2): the `n`-th is the authority `c + 1 + n` with
the slot and generation of the `n`-th handle (§38). -/
theorem mem_batchEntries : ∀ {c : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {e : Nat × Nat × Nat},
    e ∈ batchEntries c hs → ∃ n h, hs[n]? = some h ∧ e = (c + 1 + n, h.slot, h.gen)
  | _, [], _, he => by simp [batchEntries, mapI] at he
  | c, h :: hs, e, he => by
    simp only [batchEntries, mapI, List.mem_cons] at he
    rcases he with rfl | he
    · exact ⟨0, h, rfl, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨n, h', hh', rfl⟩ := mem_batchEntries (c := c + 1) he
      exact ⟨n + 1, h', by simpa using hh', by rw [show c + 1 + (n + 1) = c + 1 + 1 + n by omega]⟩

/-- Authorities after `resolve` (§60 effects; HandlePool v0.5, D.2): the companion `|A|`, then the
entry authority `|A| + 1` derived from it. -/
theorem resolve_A (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) (R : List Nat) :
    (deriveEff (compS s pl m) s.A.length R m).A = s.A ++
      [⟨m, some pl.internal, footprint s.P pl.storage, .frame s.top, true⟩,
        ⟨m, some s.A.length, R, .frame s.top, true⟩] := by
  simp [deriveEff, compS, S3.addAuth, S3.top]

/-- Authorities after `resolveMany` (§60, §61 effects; HandlePool v0.5, D.2): the companion `|A|`,
then one entry authority per handle, derived from it. -/
theorem resolveMany_A (m : Mode) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) :
    (entriesEff m (compS s pl m) s.A.length (entryRegions s pl hs)).A = s.A ++
      ⟨m, some pl.internal, footprint s.P pl.storage, .frame s.top, true⟩ ::
        hs.map fun h => ⟨m, some s.A.length, footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot), .frame s.top,
          true⟩ := by
  rw [entriesEff_eq]; simp [compS, deriveEff, S3.addAuth, S3.top, entryRegions]

/-! ## Ghost well-formedness of the pool layer (HandlePool v0.5, D.1, D.2; auxiliary) -/

/-- What `allocSlot` and `freeSlot` keep of a pool: identity, storage, `internal` and slot places
(HandlePool v0.5, D.1, D.3; auxiliary information, §38). -/
structure PoolShape where
  id : Nat
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  places : List Nat

/-- The shape of a pool (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; auxiliary; §38). -/
def Pool.shape (pl : Pool) : PoolShape := ⟨pl.id, pl.storage, pl.internal, pl.slots.map (·.place)⟩

/-- Updating a slot with the same place keeps the shape (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §38). -/
theorem setSlot_shape {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl x : Slot} (hs : pl.slots[i]? = some sl)
    (hx : x.place = sl.place) : (setSlot pl i x).shape = pl.shape := by
  simp only [Pool.shape, setSlot, map_set_same (·.place) hs hx]

/-- Well-formedness of a pool shape (auxiliary, not a clause of the contract; HandlePool v0.5, D.1,
from `newPool`): `internal` is a `Modify` authority whose footprint is the footprint of the storage
(§76.2, §76.3); the storage and every slot have a leaf; slots lie in the storage and are pairwise
disjoint (D.1). -/
structure PoolOK (s : S3) (sh : PoolShape) : Prop where
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, with own mode `Modify` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  internalMode : OptP (s.A[sh.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) = footprint(storage)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp sh.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage
  /-- §40, §49.2: the storage has a leaf (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  storageLeaf : ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage
  /-- §40, §49.2: every slot has a leaf (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  slotLeaf : ∀ q ∈ sh.places, ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P q
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: slots lie in the storage. -/
  slotIn : ∀ q ∈ sh.places, ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: slots are pairwise disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ∀ (a b qa qb : Nat), sh.places[a]? = some qa → sh.places[b]? = some qb → a ≠ b →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P qa, l ∉ footprint s.P qb

/-- Well-formedness of a ghost resolution (auxiliary, HandlePool v0.5, D.2): it belongs to a pool
of `shs` with its `internal`; the companion is younger than `internal`, of the mode of the
resolution, over the footprint of the storage; each entry authority is younger than the companion,
over the footprint of its slot (§38, §60). -/
def ResOK (s : S3) (shs : List PoolShape) (r : Res) : Prop :=
  ∃ sh ∈ shs, sh.id = r.pool ∧ sh.internal = r.internal ∧ r.internal < r.comp ∧
    OptP (s.A[r.comp]?) (fun y => y.mode = r.mode ∧
      ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage) False ∧
    ∀ e ∈ r.entries, r.comp < e.1 ∧ ∃ q, sh.places[e.2.1]? = some q ∧
      OptP (s.A[e.1]?) (fun y => ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q) False

/-- Ghost well-formedness of the pool layer (auxiliary, not a clause of the contract;
HandlePool v0.5, D.1, D.2): fresh distinct identities, well-formed pools and resolutions (§38). -/
structure PoolWF (L : PState) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: identities are below the next fresh identity. -/
  ids : ∀ sh ∈ L.pools.map Pool.shape, sh.id < L.nId
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: identities are distinct. -/
  nodup : ((L.pools.map Pool.shape).map (·.id)).Nodup
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: every pool is well formed. -/
  pools : ∀ sh ∈ L.pools.map Pool.shape, PoolOK L.kern sh
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.2: every ghost resolution is well formed. -/
  res : ∀ r ∈ L.res, ResOK L.kern (L.pools.map Pool.shape) r

/-- Exclusivity of the companions of a pool (HandlePool v0.5, D.2 restricted to the companions of
the pool, HP5-4; non-normative library contract): two distinct active companions of the same pool
are both `Observe` (§43, §50). -/
def CompExcl (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool → r₁.comp ≠ r₂.comp →
    L.kern.Active r₁.comp → L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .observe ∧ r₂.mode = .observe

/-- Footprints of every place with a leaf are kept (§40; support for HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def FpKeep (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q l₀, l₀ ∈ footprint s.P q → ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q

Runs from `PState.init Witness.hst` under the test contract `Examples.K0` (§48). Statics (§47):
place 0 is the pool storage, with two leaf children 1 and 2 (`Uninit`); place 3 is the pool value
(`Init`); place 4 is a destination (`Uninit`); root authorities 0, 1 and 2 cover places 0, 3 and 4.
`internal` is authority 3, derived from 0 over `[1, 2]` and stored in place 3. Every precondition is
decided by `decide`. -/

namespace Witness

open Examples

/-- Statics of the witnesses (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def hst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false),
    ((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.5). -/
def w0 : PState := PState.init hst

/-- After `derive(0, [1, 2], Modify)` (§60): authority 3, the future `internal`
(HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def w1 : PState := { w0 with kern := deriveEff w0.kern 0 [1, 2] .modify }

/-- After `store(3, 3)` (§65): `internal` is held by the pool value, place 3 (HandlePool v0.5,
D.1). -/
def w2 : PState := { w1 with kern := storeEff w1.kern 3 3 }

/-- After `newPool(0, 3)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1): pool 0 with slots 1 and 2, free, of generation 0
(§47). -/
def w3 : PState := newPoolEff w2 0 3

/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §47). -/
def pl3 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩

/-- After `allocSlot(0, 4)` on slot 0 (HandlePool v0.5, D.3): the handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is written
into place 4 (§47, §67). -/
def w4 : PState := allocSlotEff w3 0 pl3 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 4

/-- Pool 0 after `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §47). -/
def pl4 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩

/-- `newPool(0, 3)` is accepted on `w2` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76). -/
theorem w3_step : NewPoolStep [] 0 3 w2 (.ok w3) := Guarded.ok (by decide)

/-- `allocSlot(0, 4)` is accepted on `w3`, on slot 0 (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §67). -/
theorem w4_step : AllocSlotStep 0 4 w3 (.ok w4) := .ok (pl := pl3) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl

/-- `w3` is library-reachable (§47, §60, §65; HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
theorem w3_reach : PReach K0 hst w3 :=
  .step (.step (.step .init (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.newPool w3_step)

/-- `w4` is library-reachable (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §47, §67). -/
theorem w4_reach : PReach K0 hst w4 := .step w3_reach (.allocSlot w4_step)

/-- `resolveMany` in `Observe` accepts a repeated valid handle (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: "la
répétition du même handle valide est permise"): two `Observe` entry authorities on slot 0, derived
from one `Observe` companion; the same batch in `Modify` fails (§60). -/
theorem observe_repeat_ok :
    (∃ L', ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .observe w4 (.ok L') ∧ PReach K0 hst L' ∧

    ∀ o, ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .modify w4 o → o = .fail := by
  have hok : ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .observe w4 (.ok _) :=

/-- After `enterFrame([4], [(none, 0)])` (§72): frame 1 holds authority 4 and owns the local leaf

/-- After `resolve(0, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, Modify)` in frame 1 (HandlePool v0.5, D.2): the companion 6 over

  kern := deriveEff (compS x2.kern pl4 .modify) x2.kern.A.length (footprint x2.kern.P 1) .modify

/-- After the kernel `write` of slot place 1 through the entry authority 7 (§67; HandlePool v0.5,

def x4 : PState := { x3 with kern := write3Eff x3.kern [1] }

/-- After the kernel `transfer(1, 5)` of the entry's value to the local (§63; HandlePool v0.5,

def x5 : PState := { x4 with kern := transferEff x4.kern 1 5 }

/-- After `unresolve(6)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2): `release` of the entry authority 7, then of the
companion 6 (§62). -/
def x6 : PState := { x5 with kern := releaseEff (releaseEff x5.kern 7) 6 }

/-- After `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1): slot 0 is free, of generation 1; the

def x7 : PState := freeSlotEff x6 0 pl4 0 ⟨1, 0, true⟩

to a local of the same shape (§63), `unresolve`, then `freeSlot` accepted. `internal` (authority 3)

transfer is accepted through the exemption of v0.1 §63.4: the entry authority 7, which grounds the

free with generation 1, slot place 1 is `Moved` and the local is `Init`. -/
theorem freeSlot_after_transfer :
    NewPoolStep [] 0 3 w2 (.ok w3) ∧ AllocSlotStep 0 4 w3 (.ok w4) ∧
    ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify x2 (.ok x3) ∧ Write3Step 7 [1] x3.kern (.ok x4.kern) ∧
