    FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ x6 (.ok x7) ∧ PReach K0 hst x7 ∧
    x7.kern.A[3]? = some ⟨.modify, some 0, [1, 2], .place 3, true⟩ ∧
    x7.kern.P[5]? = some ⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩ ∧ x7.kern.top = 1 ∧
    x7.kern.I 1 = .moved ∧ x7.kern.I 5 = .init ∧
    x7.pools[0]? = some ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 1, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩ := by
  have r3 : ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify x2 (.ok x3) :=
    .ok (pl := pl4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
  have w4' : Write3Step 7 [1] x3.kern (.ok x4.kern) := Guarded.ok (by decide)
  have t5 : TransferStep K0 1 5 x4.kern (.ok x5.kern) := Guarded.ok (by decide)
  have hrel : releaseAll x5.kern (unresolveList x5.kern ⟨0, 3, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩) =
      some x6.kern := by
    have e : unresolveList x5.kern ⟨0, 3, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩ = [7, 6] := by decide
    have h7 : ReleasePre x5.kern 7 := by decide
    have h6 : ReleasePre (releaseEff x5.kern 7) 6 := by decide
    rw [e]; simp only [releaseAll, h7, h6, ↓reduceIte]; rfl
  have u6 : UnresolveStep 6 x5 (.ok x6) := .ok (r := ⟨0, 3, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩) rfl hrel
  have f7 : FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ x6 (.ok x7) :=
    .ok (pl := pl4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
  have h2 : PReach K0 hst x2 := .step (.step w4_reach (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
    (.kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have h7 : PReach K0 hst x7 :=
    .step (.step (.step (.step (.step h2 (.resolve r3)) (.kernel (.write w4')))
      (.kernel (.transfer t5))) (.unresolve u6)) (.freeSlot f7)
  exact ⟨w3_step, w4_step, r3, w4', t5, u6, f7, h7, by decide, by decide, rfl, by decide,
    by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### `freeSlot` after a frame exit (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (2), HP5-1'; §42, §73)

Statics `cst` (§47): place 0 is the pool storage with leaf children 1 and 2 (`Uninit`); place 3 is
the pool value (`Init`); place 4 is the handle destination; place 5 is a leaf of frame 0. Root
authorities 0 to 3 cover places 0, 3, 4 and 5. Frame 1 resolves the handle in `Modify`; the entry
authority is stored into place 5 of frame 0; at the exit of frame 1 the companion dies and the entry
authority is reanchored to `internal` (§73.4); `freeSlot` is then rejected (HP5-1'). -/

/-- Statics of the run (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def cst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false),
    ((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
/-- After `derive(0, [1, 2], Modify)` (§60): `internal` is authority 4 (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def c1 : PState := { PState.init cst with kern := deriveEff (PState.init cst).kern 0 [1, 2] .modify }
/-- After `store(4, 3)` (§65): `internal` is held by the pool value (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def c2 : PState := { c1 with kern := storeEff c1.kern 4 3 }
/-- After `newPool(0, 4)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §76). -/
def c3 : PState := newPoolEff c2 0 4
/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §47). -/
def pA : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
/-- After `allocSlot(0, 4)`: the handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is written into place 4 (HandlePool v0.5, D.3;
§67). -/
def c4 : PState := allocSlotEff c3 0 pA 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 4
/-- Pool 0 after `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §47). -/
def pA4 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
/-- After `derive(1, [3], Modify)`: authority 5 over the pool value (§60; HandlePool v0.5). -/
def c5 : PState := { c4 with kern := deriveEff c4.kern 1 [3] .modify }
/-- After `derive(3, [5], Modify)`: authority 6 over place 5 (§60; HandlePool v0.5). -/
def c6 : PState := { c5 with kern := deriveEff c5.kern 3 [5] .modify }
/-- After `enterFrame([5, 6], [])`: frame 1 (§72; HandlePool v0.5). -/
def c7 : PState := { c6 with kern := enterEff c6.kern [5, 6] [] }
/-- After `resolve(0, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, Modify)` in frame 1: companion 7, entry authority 8 over slot
place 1 (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60). -/
def c8 : PState := { c7 with
  kern := deriveEff (compS c7.kern pA4 .modify) c7.kern.A.length (footprint c7.kern.P 1) .modify
  res := c7.res ++ [⟨pA4.id, pA4.internal, c7.kern.A.length, .modify,
    [(c7.kern.A.length + 1, 0, 0)]⟩] }
/-- After `store(8, 5)`: the entry authority is held by place 5 of frame 0 (HandlePool v0.5;
§65). -/
def c9 : PState := { c8 with kern := storeEff c8.kern 8 5 }
/-- After `exitFrame`: the companion 7 dies with frame 1; the entry authority 8 survives,
reanchored to `internal` 4 (§73; HandlePool v0.5). -/
def c10 : PState := { c9 with kern := exitEff c9.kern }
/-- The run of HP5-1' after a frame exit (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (2), HP5-1'; non-normative library
contract): `c10` is library-reachable; the entry authority 8, recorded for slot 0 at generation 0,
is active `Modify` over slot place 1, held by place 5 of frame 0, with origin `internal` 4
(reanchored, §73.4) while its companion 7 is inactive; it is a strict descendant of `internal`
covering the slot, so `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` rejects, and `reject` is its only outcome. -/
theorem no_stale_after_exit :
    PReach K0 cst c10 ∧ (⟨0, 4, 7, .modify, [(8, 0, 0)]⟩ : Res) ∈ c10.res ∧
    c10.kern.A[8]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [1], .place 5, true⟩ ∧ ¬ c10.kern.Active 7 ∧
    c10.pools[0]? = some pA4 ∧ 4 ∈ c10.kern.ancs 8 ∧
    FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ c10 .reject ∧ ∀ o, FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ c10 o → o = .reject := by
  have h3 : PReach K0 cst c3 :=
    .step (.step (.step .init (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
      (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
  have h4 : PReach K0 cst c4 := .step h3 (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := pA) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))
  have h7 : PReach K0 cst c7 :=
    .step (.step (.step h4 (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
      (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have r8 : ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify c7 (.ok c8) :=
    .ok (pl := pA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
  have h10 : PReach K0 cst c10 := .step (.step (.step h7 (.resolve r8))
    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.exit (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  exact ⟨h10, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl, by decide,
    pool_freeSlot_content_rejects (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl
      (by decide)⟩

/-! ### The write of HP5-3 on a pool value with a `Moved` leaf (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-3; §63, §67)

Statics `vst` (§47): place 0, the pool value, `Init`, with leaves 1 and 2; place 3, the storage,
owned by place 0, with `Uninit` leaves 4 and 5; place 6, an `Uninit` leaf of frame 0. `internal`
is the root authority 1 of the storage, held by its owner, place 0. -/

/-- Statics of the run (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def vst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
    ((none, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false),
    ((none, none, 0), false)]
/-- After `newPool(3, 1)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §76). -/
def m1 : PState := newPoolEff (PState.init vst) 3 1
/-- After the kernel `transfer(1, 6)` of leaf 1 of the pool value to place 6 (HandlePool v0.5;
§63). -/
def m2 : PState := { m1 with kern := transferEff m1.kern 1 6 }
/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §47). -/
def pv : Pool := ⟨0, 3, 1, [⟨4, 0, false⟩, ⟨5, 0, false⟩]⟩

/-- Limit of HP5-3 (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-3; non-normative library contract): `m2` is
library-reachable, pool 0 has `AdminRight` (§36) and its value, place 0, has the `Moved` leaf 1
(§63); the write of the leaves of the pool value (§67) that `freeSlot_meta_write` provides is then
not the identity on the kernel state, while `freeSlot` leaves the kernel state unchanged
(`freeSlot_effect`). -/
theorem meta_write_not_identity :
    StaticsOK vst ∧ PReach K0 vst m2 ∧ m2.pools[0]? = some pv ∧ AdminRight m2.kern pv ∧
    Arena.arenaValue m2.kern pv.entry = some 0 ∧ m2.kern.I 1 = .moved ∧
    write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := by
  have hne : write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := fun e => by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun s : S3 => s.I 1) e
    have : (write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0)).I 1 = .init := by decide
    have h2 : m2.kern.I 1 = .moved := by decide
    rw [this, h2] at h1; cases h1
  exact ⟨by decide, .step (.step .init (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
    (.kernel (.transfer (Guarded.ok (by decide)))), rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, hne⟩

end Witness

end Ern.Lib.HandlePool

z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
static (§49.2). -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
dynamic pinning obligation. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pins := [] }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/

/-! ## O8 `store` (§65) -/

/-- Effect of `store(authority, target)` (§65, `ok` effect): `target` becomes the holder, the
authority joins `D(target)`, and only leaf `target` becomes `Init`. -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))

/-- Effect of `enterFrame(params, locals)` (§72, `ok` effect): a new frame `nF` is pushed; the
parameters are now held by it; locals are appended (uninitialized, no anchor, alive) with one
active root `Modify` authority per root local, held by the new frame; pinning obligations are
unchanged. -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
        ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    pins := s.pins }

/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
not represented. -/
structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with
    F := s.F.tail
    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
  dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)

  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

{L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) : CompExcl L := by
  induction h with
  | init => intro r hr; simp [PState.init] at hr
  | step hr hs ih =>
    exact pstep_compExcl (kernel_guarantee hdd hst _ hr).2.1.1.1 (pReach_poolWF hr) ih hs

/-! ## `PoolInv` (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 per pool, HP5-4) -/

/-- `PoolInv`, item 1 (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (1); non-normative library contract): the entries of
every pool lie in its storage and are pairwise disjoint (§40). -/
def EntriesDisjoint (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ pl ∈ L.pools,
    (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P sl.place, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P pl.storage) ∧
    ∀ (a b : Nat) (sa sb : Slot), pl.slots[a]? = some sa → pl.slots[b]? = some sb → a ≠ b →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P sa.place, l ∉ footprint L.kern.P sb.place

/-- `PoolInv`, item 2, `pool_no_stale_access` as a state predicate (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (2);
non-normative library contract): no active entry authority designates a free slot or a former
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) :
    ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool → L.kern.Active r₁.comp →
      L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify → r₁.comp = r₂.comp := by
  intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp ha₁ ha₂ hm
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hne => ?_
  have := pReach_compExcl hdd hst h r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂
  rw [hm] at this; cases this.1

/-! ## Handle validation: dead pool, other pool, stale, absent or free slot (HandlePool v0.5, D.2,
D.3, HP5-5, HP5-6, HP5-1''; §89) -/

/-- A handle of a dead pool is not valid (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-5; §46 analogue, §89). -/
theorem not_handleOK_dead {s : S3} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} (hd : ¬ s.Active pl.internal) :
    ¬ HandleOK s pl h :=
  fun ⟨ha, _⟩ => hd ha

/-- A handle of another pool is not valid (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, D.3; §89). -/
theorem not_handleOK_other {s : S3} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} (hid : h.id ≠ pl.id) :
    ¬ HandleOK s pl h :=
  fun ⟨_, e, _⟩ => hid e
